reconstructed_captions.18: The man finds a suitable spot near some rocks and kneels down.
reconstructed_captions.19: He clears away leaves to create a space for a fire.
reconstructed_captions.20: He gathers dry twigs and leaves to use as tinder.
reconstructed_captions.21: He arranges the tinder and kindling inside a small ring of rocks.
reconstructed_captions.22: He takes out a fire-starting tool from his pocket.
reconstructed_captions.23: He kneels over the tinder, preparing to create a spark.
reconstructed_captions.24: He strikes the tool, sending a shower of sparks onto the tinder.
reconstructed_captions.25: He strikes it again, trying to get an ember to catch.
reconstructed_captions.26: A small amount of smoke begins to rise from the tinder bundle.
reconstructed_captions.27: The man leans in close to the smoldering tinder.
reconstructed_captions.28: He begins to blow gently on the small, glowing ember.
reconstructed_captions.29: The ember glows brighter with each breath.
reconstructed_captions.30: He continues to blow steadily on the smoldering tinder.
reconstructed_captions.31: He carefully adds a few more small pieces of kindling.
reconstructed_captions.32: The smoke thickens as the tinder bundle begins to catch fire.
reconstructed_captions.33: He continues blowing on the smoldering pile to encourage it.
reconstructed_captions.34: A tiny flame flickers to life within the kindling.
reconstructed_captions.35: The man leans in and blows steadily on the new flame.
